# Pidgeon

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 c15 P40](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0040), [v1 c15 P56](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0056), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolmaster at Brierley school  <sub>[v1 c15 P56](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0056), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>
- **Titles:** Mr. Pidgeon  <sub>[v1 c15 P40](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0040)</sub>; Master  <sub>[v1 c15 P58](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0058)</sub>

## Personality

Mr. Pidgeon can be overbearing, stern, and sarcastic, often utilizing a mocking tone that stings his students. He maintains poor discipline in the classroom and tends to ignore younger pupils in favor of older ones preparing for Regent's. He can also act on sudden impulses of strictness when looking to enforce order.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P57](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0057), [v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 c15 P65](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0065), [v1 c15 P83](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0083), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)_

## Traits

- Overbearing  <sub>[v1 c15 P83](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0083)</sub>
- Sarcastic  <sub>[v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 c15 P65](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0065)</sub>
- Strict when enforcing discipline  <sub>[v1 c15 P57](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0057), [v1 c15 P63](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0063)</sub>

## Abilities

- Teaching algebra
- Preparing students for Regent's  <sub>[v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>

## Goals

- Prepare older pupils for Regent's examinations  <sub>[v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>

## History

Mr. Pidgeon served as the schoolmaster at Brierley school, lodging at the home of Eben Duckett during his tenure. While clarifying an algebra problem for Sukey Pullen, he intervened when Nell Harcourt broke her slate over Hugh Carrow's head, punishing Nell by forcing her to stand at the blackboard dais for the remainder of the day and writing a humiliating inscription above her head. On a subsequent day, he attempted to enforce strict punctuality after dinner, requiring late-arriving Nell to sit next to Hugh Carrow as a penalty. His overbearing behavior and public disciplining caused Nell to temporarily leave school to study at home instead. Local community members noted that he was ineffective as an instructor and only secured his teaching position because his uncle controlled the board of trustees.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P40](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0040), [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P46](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0046), [v1 c15 P56](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0056), [v1 c15 P57](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0057), [v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 c15 P82](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0082), [v1 c15 P83](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0083), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)_
